<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Rappi Catito</title>
<style>
:root{--g:#14532d;--g2:#1f7a45;--bg:#f8f4e8;--cd:#fffdf7;--tx:#1b2a20;--mu:#7a867e;--bd:#e3dfcf;--sf:#e2eedf;--yl:#fdf0cf;color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html,body{height:100%}
body{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;background:#c9a53a;color:var(--tx);display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
#app{width:100%;max-width:410px;height:100%;max-height:860px;background:var(--bg);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;position:relative;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(min-width:500px){#app{border-radius:36px;height:92vh;box-shadow:0 10px 40px #0006}}
.hd{background:var(--g);color:#fff;padding:14px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:none}
.hd h2{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
.hb{background:none;border:0;color:#fff;width:34px;height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}
.body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:18px;position:relative}
.btn{width:100%;background:var(--g);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:30px;padding:16px;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.lnk{background:none;border:0;color:var(--g);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;padding:8px}
.fld{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--cd);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;color:var(--g)}
.fld div{flex:1}.fld label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--tx)}.fld input{width:100%;border:0;background:none;font-size:15px;color:var(--tx);outline:none;padding:3px 0}.fld input::placeholder{color:#a9b0aa}
.err{color:#c0392b;font-size:13px;margin:-4px 0 10px}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;margin:12px 0}
.tab{border:1px solid var(--bd);background:var(--cd);color:var(--tx);border-radius:20px;padding:7px 15px;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.tab.on{background:var(--g);color:#fff;border-color:var(--g);font-weight:700}
.it{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;cursor:pointer}
.ph{width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:16px;object-fit:cover;flex:none;background:#eee}
.em{width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--sf);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:40px;flex:none}
.pl{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g);color:#fff;border:0;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.nav{display:flex;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);background:var(--cd);flex:none}
.nav button{flex:1;background:none;border:0;padding:9px;color:var(--mu);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px}.nav button.on{color:var(--g);font-weight:700}
.qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;justify-content:center;margin:16px 0}.qty button{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--bd);background:var(--cd);color:var(--g);font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:5px 0}
.pay{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px}.pay.on{background:#ecebe2}
.pay img{width:28px;height:28px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:8px}
.dot{margin-left:auto;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #b8beb9}.pay.on .dot{border:6px solid var(--g)}
.chip{display:inline-block;background:var(--sf);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--g)}
.tot{background:var(--sf);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px}
.stp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:9px 0;position:relative}
.ck{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #b8beb9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;flex:none;background:var(--cd)}.ck.on{background:var(--g);border-color:var(--g)}.ck.cu{color:var(--mu)}
.stp:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:12px;top:36px;height:22px;width:2px;background:var(--g)}
.stars{color:var(--g);font-size:38px;letter-spacing:4px;cursor:pointer}.sm{font-size:22px;color:#b8beb9;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer}.sm i,.stars i{font-style:normal}.stars i.on,.sm i.on{color:var(--g)}
textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:14px;padding:12px;background:var(--cd);color:var(--tx);font:inherit;resize:none;height:90px}
.toast{position:absolute;bottom:90px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#222;color:#fff;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:20px;font-size:14px;z-index:9;white-space:nowrap}
.blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
</style></head><body><div id="app"></div>
<script>
const IM={f1:'data:image/webp;base64,',f2:'data:image/webp;base64,',f3:'data:image/webp;base64,',hero:'data:image/webp;base64,',yape:'data:image/webp;base64,',plin:'data:image/webp;base64,',efec:'data:image/webp;base64,',card:'data:image/webp;base64,',logo:'data:image/webp;base64,',head:'data:image/webp;base64,'};
const P={mail:'<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M3 7l9 6 9-6"/>',lock:'<rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V8a4 4 0 018 0v3"/>',eye:'<path d="M2 12s4-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-4 7-10 7S2 12 2 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>',id:'<rect x="5" y="4" width="14" height="17" rx="2"/><path d="M9 4V2h6v2M9 12h6M9 16h6"/>',home:'<path d="M3 11l9-8 9 8v10H3z"/>',ord:'<path d="M6 3h12v18l-3-2-3 2-3-2-3 2zM9 8h6M9 12h6"/>',user:'<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21c0-5 4-7 8-7s8 2 8 7"/>',back:'<path d="M19 12H5M12 5l-7 7 7 7"/>',trash:'<path d="M4 7h16M9 7V4h6v3M6 7l1 14h10l1-14"/>',clock:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/>',fork:'<path d="M7 3v8M5 3v5a2 2 0 004 0V3M7 11v10M17 3c-2 2-3 5-3 8h3v10"/>',box:'<path d="M4 8l8-4 8 4v9l-8 4-8-4zM4 8l8 4 8-4M12 12v9"/>',cart:'<circle cx="9" cy="20" r="1.5"/><circle cx="18" cy="20" r="1.5"/><path d="M2 3h3l3 12h11l2-8H6"/>',chk:'<path d="M5 12l5 5 9-10"/>',cap:'<path d="M2 9l10-5 10 5-10 5zM6 11v5c3 3 9 3 12 0v-5"/>'};
const I=(n,s=22)=>`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${s}" height="${s}" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${P[n]}</svg>`;
const PAW=`<svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" width="34" fill="#b7d6b9"><ellipse cx="20" cy="27" rx="9" ry="7"/><circle cx="8" cy="17" r="4"/><circle cx="16" cy="10" r="4"/><circle cx="25" cy="10" r="4"/><circle cx="33" cy="17" r="4"/></svg>`;
const M=[
{id:1,n:'Pollo a la plancha',d:'con arroz y ensalada',p:12,c:'Almuerzos',e:'🍗',l:'Pechuga de pollo a la plancha, arroz blanco, ensalada fresca y papas al vapor.'},
{id:2,n:'Lomo saltado',d:'con arroz y papas',p:14,c:'Almuerzos',e:'🥩',l:'Trozos de res salteados al wok con cebolla, tomate y papas fritas.'},
{id:3,n:'Tallarín verde',d:'con pollo',p:11,c:'Almuerzos',e:'🍝',l:'Tallarines en salsa de albahaca y espinaca con pollo a la plancha.'},
{id:4,n:'Ají de gallina',d:'con arroz',p:13,c:'Almuerzos',e:'🍛',l:'Crema de ají amarillo con pollo deshilachado, huevo y aceituna.'},
{id:5,n:'Chicha morada',d:'vaso 500 ml',p:4,c:'Bebidas',e:'🥤',l:'Bebida de maíz morado, piña y canela.'},
{id:6,n:'Limonada frozen',d:'vaso 500 ml',p:5,c:'Bebidas',e:'🍋',l:'Limonada helada con hierbabuena.'},
{id:7,n:'Empanada de carne',d:'horneada',p:4,c:'Snacks',e:'🥟',l:'Empanada horneada rellena de carne y cebolla.'},
{id:8,n:'Brownie',d:'con nueces',p:5,c:'Snacks',e:'🍫',l:'Brownie de chocolate con nueces.'}];
const PAY=[['Yape','yape'],['Plin','plin'],['Efectivo','efec'],['Tarjeta de débito/crédito','card']];
const STG=[['En preparación','Restaurante'],['Listo para recoger','En cocina'],['En camino','Repartidor'],['Entregado','¡Buen provecho!']];
const PH={1:IM.f1,2:IM.f2,3:IM.f3};
let S={user:null,orders:[],seq:246,cart:{}},cur='splash',cat='Todos',sel=null,qty=1,pay=0,err='',R={},cm='',ord=null,toast='';
try{const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rc'));if(x)S=Object.assign(S,x);if(S.user)cur='home'}catch(e){}
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('rc',JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}};
const $=n=>'S/ '+n.toFixed(2);
const go=s=>{cur=s;err='';render()};
const tot=()=>{let s=0;for(const k in S.cart)s+=M.find(m=>m.id==k).p*S.cart[k];return{s,d:s*.15,t:s*.85}};
const cnt=()=>Object.values(S.cart).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
const th=(m,z)=>PH[m.id]?`<img class="ph" src="${PH[m.id]}" style="${z?`width:${z}px;height:${z}px`:''}" alt="${m.n}">`:`<div class="em" style="${z?`width:${z}px;height:${z}px;font-size:${z/2}px`:''}">${m.e}</div>`;
const hd=(t,b)=>`<div class="hd"><button class="hb" onclick="${b}">${I('back')}</button><h2>${t}</h2><span class="hb"></span></div>`;
const nav=a=>`<div class="nav">${[['home','home','Inicio'],['orders','ord','Pedidos'],['profile','user','Perfil']].map(x=>`<button class="${a==x[0]?'on':''}" onclick="go('${x[0]}')">${I(x[1],24)}${x[2]}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
const stars=(k,sm)=>[1,2,3,4,5].map(i=>`<i class="${(R[k]||0)>=i?'on':''}" onclick="R['${k}']=${i};render()">${(R[k]||0)>=i?'★':sm?'☆':'★'}</i>`).join('');
const lab=o=>o.stage>=4?'Entregado':STG[o.stage][0];
function fecha(){const d=new Date(),w=['domingo','lunes','martes','miércoles','jueves','viernes','sábado'][d.getDay()],m=['enero','febrero','marzo','abril','mayo','junio','julio','agosto','setiembre','octubre','noviembre','diciembre'][d.getMonth()];return w[0].toUpperCase()+w.slice(1)+', '+d.getDate()+' de '+m}
const V={
splash:()=>`<div class="blob" style="width:150px;height:200px;background:#cfe3d0;left:-60px;top:20px"></div><div class="blob" style="width:200px;height:200px;background:#cfe3d0;right:-70px;bottom:-50px"></div><div style="position:absolute;right:16px;top:20px;opacity:.7">${PAW}</div><div style="position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:18px;opacity:.7">${PAW}</div><div class="body" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center"><img src="${IM.logo}" alt="Rappi Catito, tu almuerzo universitario, más fácil" style="width:min(270px,70vw)"></div><div style="padding:0 40px 40px;position:relative"><button class="btn" onclick="go('signup')">Comenzar</button></div>`,
signup:()=>`${hd('Crear cuenta',"go('splash')")}<div class="body" style="padding-top:26px"><div class="blob" style="width:110px;height:110px;background:#f2c2ae;left:-40px;bottom:-30px"></div><div class="blob" style="width:200px;height:170px;background:#cfe3d0;right:-60px;bottom:-40px"></div><div style="position:relative"><div class="fld">${I('mail')}<div><label>Correo institucional</label><input id="em" placeholder="@ucsm.edu.pe" type="email"></div></div><div class="fld">${I('lock')}<div><label>Contraseña</label><input id="pw" type="password"></div>${I('eye')}</div><div class="fld">${I('id')}<div><label>Código universitario</label><input id="cd" placeholder="(ej. 20240001)" inputmode="numeric"></div></div><p class="err">${err}</p><button class="btn" style="margin-top:8px" onclick="signup()">Crear cuenta</button><p style="text-align:center;margin-top:22px;color:var(--tx)">¿Ya tienes cuenta?<br><button class="lnk" onclick="signup(1)">Inicia sesión</button></p></div></div>`,
home:()=>{const l=M.filter(m=>cat=='Todos'||m.c==cat);return `<div class="hd"><img src="${IM.head}" width="38" height="38" style="border-radius:50%" alt=""><h2 style="text-align:left">Rappi Catito</h2><button class="hb" onclick="go('cart')" style="width:auto;gap:4px">${I('cart')}${cnt()||''}</button></div><div class="body"><h2 style="color:var(--g);font-size:21px">¡Hola, ${S.user.name}!</h2><p style="color:var(--mu);margin:4px 0 12px">Hoy tenemos un menú especial<br>para ti.</p><span class="chip">${fecha()}</span><div class="tabs">${['Todos','Almuerzos','Bebidas','Snacks'].map(c=>`<button class="tab ${cat==c?'on':''}" onclick="cat='${c}';render()">${c}</button>`).join('')}</div>${l.map(m=>`<div class="it" onclick="sel=M[${M.indexOf(m)}];qty=1;go('detail')">${th(m)}<div style="flex:1"><b>${m.n}</b><div style="color:var(--mu);font-size:13px">${m.d}</div><b style="display:block;margin-top:8px">${$(m.p)}</b></div><button class="pl" onclick="event.stopPropagation();add(${m.id},1);msg('Agregado al carrito')">+</button></div>`).join('')}</div>${nav('home')}`},
detail:()=>{const m=sel;return `<div class="hd"><button class="hb" onclick="go('home')">${I('back')}</button><h2></h2><button class="hb" onclick="go('cart')">${I('cart')}</button></div><div class="body" style="padding:0"><div style="background:#e9e6dc;border-radius:0 0 40px 40px;overflow:hidden;height:170px;display:flex;justify-content:center">${m.id==1?`<img src="${IM.hero}" style="height:100%;width:100%;object-fit:cover" alt="">`:th(m,170)}</div><div style="padding:18px"><h2 style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.25">${m.n}<br>${m.d}</h2><p style="color:var(--mu);font-size:14px;margin:8px 0 12px">${m.l}</p><hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)"><div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><span>Precio original</span><b>${$(m.p)}</b></div><div style="background:var(--yl);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:8px 0;color:var(--g)">${I('cap',28)}<div style="flex:1"><b>Descuento estudiante</b><div><b>15%</b></div></div><b>- ${$(m.p*.15)}</b></div><div class="row" style="font-size:20px"><b>Precio final</b><b>${$(m.p*.85)}</b></div><div class="qty"><button onclick="qty=Math.max(1,qty-1);render()">−</button><b style="font-size:22px">${qty}</b><button onclick="qty++;render()">+</button></div><button class="btn" onclick="add(${m.id},qty);go('home')">Agregar al carrito</button></div></div>`},
cart:()=>{const t=tot(),ids=Object.keys(S.cart);return `${hd('Mi carrito',"go('home')")}<div class="body">${ids.length?ids.map(k=>{const m=M.find(x=>x.id==k);return `<div class="it" style="cursor:default;margin-bottom:10px">${th(m,56)}<div style="flex:1"><b>${m.n}</b><div style="color:var(--mu);font-size:13px">${m.d}</div><b>${$(m.p*.85)}</b><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:4px"><button class="pl" style="background:none;color:var(--g);border:1px solid var(--g);width:24px;height:24px;font-size:16px;line-height:1" onclick="add(${k},-1)">−</button><b>${S.cart[k]}</b><button class="pl" style="background:none;color:var(--g);border:1px solid var(--g);width:24px;height:24px;font-size:16px;line-height:1" onclick="add(${k},1)">+</button></div></div><button class="hb" style="color:var(--g)" onclick="add(${k},-99)">${I('trash',20)}</button></div>`}).join('')+`<hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);margin:12px 0"><h3 style="margin-bottom:6px">Método de pago</h3>${PAY.map((p,i)=>`<div class="pay ${pay==i?'on':''}" onclick="pay=${i};render()"><img src="${IM[p[1]]}" alt="">${p[0]}<span class="dot"></span></div>`).join('')}<div class="tot" style="margin:14px 0"><div class="row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${$(t.s)}</span></div><div class="row" style="color:var(--g)"><span>Descuento estudiante (15%)</span><span>- ${$(t.d)}</span></div><div class="row" style="font-size:20px"><b>Total</b><b>${$(t.t)}</b></div></div><button class="btn" onclick="confirmar()">Confirmar pedido</button>`:'<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:60px;color:var(--mu)">Tu carrito está vacío</p>'}</div>`},
done:()=>`<div style="background:var(--g);height:56px;flex:none"></div><div class="body" style="margin-top:-30px;border-radius:36px 36px 0 0;background:var(--bg);text-align:center"><div style="position:relative;height:96px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center"><svg viewBox="0 0 200 100" width="200" style="position:absolute"><path d="M30 20l9 9M8 52h12M170 20l-9 9M192 52h-12M100 4v10" stroke="#e8923a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M56 6l5 8M144 6l-5 8" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg><div style="width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative">${I('chk',44)}</div></div><h2 style="color:var(--g);font-size:26px;margin-top:10px">¡Pago confirmado!</h2><p style="color:var(--mu);margin:8px 0 20px">Tu pedido ha sido registrado<br>correctamente.</p><p>Número de pedido</p><h1 style="color:var(--g);font-size:34px;margin-bottom:12px">${ord.id}</h1><div style="text-align:left;background:var(--cd);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:16px;padding:6px 16px">${[[`<img src="${IM[PAY.find(p=>p[0]==ord.pay)?.[1]||'efec']}" width="30" height="30" style="border-radius:8px" alt="">`,'Método de pago',ord.pay],[`<span style="color:var(--g)">${I('box',30)}</span>`,'Total pagado',$(ord.total)],[`<span style="color:var(--g)">${I('clock',30)}</span>`,'Tiempo estimado de entrega','20 - 30 min']].map(r=>`<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)">${r[0]}<div><div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--mu)">${r[1]}</div><b style="font-size:19px">${r[2]}</b></div></div>`).join('').replace(/border-bottom:1px solid var\(--bd\)">(?=(?:(?!border-bottom)[\s\S])*$)/,'">')}</div><button class="btn" style="margin-top:20px" onclick="go('orders')">Ver mis pedidos</button><button class="lnk" onclick="go('home')">Volver al inicio</button></div>`,
track:()=>{const o=ord,st=o.stage,eta=[28,22,15,5,0][st];return `${hd('Mi pedido',"go('home')")}<div class="body" style="padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column"><svg viewBox="0 0 300 250" style="width:100%;flex:none;background:#eef0e8"><path d="M0 70H300M0 150H300M60 0V250M170 0V250M260 0V250M0 215L300 190" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="9" fill="none"/><rect x="190" y="160" width="110" height="90" fill="#cfe5c5" opacity=".8"/><path id="rt" d="M80 218C80 165 120 170 130 125S190 95 205 60" stroke="var(--g)" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M80 226c-8-9-10-13-10-17a10 10 0 0120 0c0 4-2 8-10 17z" fill="var(--g)"/><circle cx="80" cy="209" r="3.5" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="238" cy="38" r="20" fill="var(--g)"/><g transform="translate(226 26)" stroke="#fff" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M1 22h22M3 22V10M9 22V10M15 22V10M21 22V10M0 10l12-8 12 8z"/></g><text x="238" y="72" font-size="10" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--g)">Campus UCSM</text><g id="cp" style="transition:transform 1.2s"><circle r="19" fill="#fff" stroke="var(--g)" stroke-width="3"/><image href="${IM.head}" x="-16" y="-16" width="32" height="32"/></g></svg><div style="margin:-14px 16px 6px;background:var(--cd);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;position:relative"><b style="font-size:17px">${st>=4?'¡Tu pedido llegó!':'Tu pedido está en camino'}</b><div style="color:var(--g);font-size:14px">${st>=4?'Califica tu experiencia':'Llegará en '+(eta-5)+' - '+eta+' min'}</div></div><div style="padding:6px 20px 16px">${STG.map((s,i)=>`<div class="stp"><div class="ck ${st>i?'on':'cu'}">${st>i?I('chk',16):I('clock',14)}</div><div style="flex:1"><b>${s[0]}</b><div style="color:var(--mu);font-size:13px">${s[1]}</div></div><div class="ck ${st>i?'on':''}">${st>i?I('chk',16):''}</div></div>`).join('')}${st>=4?`<button class="btn" style="margin-top:10px" onclick="R={};cm='';go('rate')">Calificar servicio</button>`:''}</div></div>`},
rate:()=>`${hd('Calificación',"go('track')")}<div class="body" style="text-align:center"><img src="${IM.head}" width="70" height="70" style="border-radius:50%" alt=""><h3 style="color:var(--g);font-size:19px;margin-bottom:12px">Rappi Catito</h3><h2 style="font-size:19px">¿Cómo fue tu experiencia?</h2><p style="color:var(--mu);margin:4px 0 12px;font-size:14px">Tu opinión nos ayuda a mejorar.</p><div class="stars">${stars('o')}</div><p style="color:var(--g);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin:2px 0 14px">Califica el servicio</p>${[['f','fork','Comida'],['t','clock','Tiempo de entrega'],['a','user','Atención']].map(x=>`<div class="row" style="padding:9px 0"><span style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;color:var(--g)">${I(x[1],22)}<span style="color:var(--tx);font-size:14px">${x[2]}</span></span><span class="sm">${stars(x[0],1)}</span></div>`).join('')}<textarea id="cm" maxlength="200" placeholder="Deja un comentario (opcional)" oninput="cm=this.value;cc.textContent=cm.length+'/200'" style="margin-top:8px">${cm}</textarea><div id="cc" style="text-align:right;font-size:11px;color:var(--mu);margin:2px 4px 12px">${cm.length}/200</div><button class="btn" onclick="sendRate()">Enviar calificación</button></div>`,
orders:()=>`<div class="hd"><h2>Mis pedidos</h2></div><div class="body">${S.orders.length?S.orders.slice().reverse().map(o=>`<div style="background:var(--cd);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:16px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer" onclick="ord=S.orders.find(x=>x.id=='${o.id}');go('track')"><div class="row"><b style="color:var(--g)">${o.id}</b><b>${$(o.total)}</b></div><div style="color:var(--mu);font-size:13px">${o.items}</div><span class="chip" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:13px">${lab(o)}${o.rating?' · '+'★'.repeat(o.rating):''}</span></div>`).join(''):'<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:60px;color:var(--mu)">Aún no tienes pedidos</p>'}</div>${nav('orders')}`,
profile:()=>`<div class="hd"><h2>Mi perfil</h2></div><div class="body" style="text-align:center"><img src="${IM.head}" width="110" height="110" style="border-radius:50%;margin-top:10px" alt=""><h2 style="margin-top:8px">${S.user.name}</h2><p style="color:var(--mu)">${S.user.email}</p><p style="color:var(--mu)">Código: ${S.user.code}</p><div style="margin:18px 0;background:var(--yl);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;color:var(--g)">Descuento estudiante activo: <b>15%</b></div><p style="color:var(--mu)">${S.orders.length} pedido(s) realizados</p><button class="lnk" onclick="S.user=null;S.cart={};save();go('splash')">Cerrar sesión</button></div>${nav('profile')}`};
function add(id,n){S.cart[id]=(S.cart[id]||0)+n;if(S.cart[id]<=0)delete S.cart[id];save();if(cur=='cart')render()}
function msg(t){toast=t;render();setTimeout(()=>{toast='';render()},1200)}
function signup(login){const e=em.value.trim().toLowerCase(),p=pw.value,c=cd.value.trim();
if(!/^[^@\s]+@ucsm\.edu\.pe$/.test(e))return err='Usa tu correo institucional @ucsm.edu.pe',render();
if(p.length<6)return err='La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres',render();
if(!/^\d{8}$/.test(c)&&!login)return err='El código universitario tiene 8 dígitos',render();
const n=e.split('@')[0].split('.')[0];S.user={email:e,code:c||'—',name:n[0].toUpperCase()+n.slice(1)};save();go('home')}
function confirmar(){if(!cnt())return;const t=tot();S.seq++;ord={id:'T-'+String(S.seq).padStart(4,'0'),pay:PAY[pay][0],total:t.t,stage:0,rating:0,items:Object.keys(S.cart).map(k=>S.cart[k]+'× '+M.find(m=>m.id==k).n).join(', ')};S.orders.push(ord);S.cart={};save();go('done')}
function sendRate(){if(!R.o)return msg('Elige una calificación');ord.rating=R.o;save();msg('¡Gracias por tu opinión!');setTimeout(()=>go('home'),1000)}
setInterval(()=>{const o=S.orders.find(x=>x.stage<4);if(o){o.stage++;save();if(cur=='track'&&ord&&ord.id==o.id)render()}},7000);
function render(){const a=document.getElementById('app');a.innerHTML=V[cur]()+(toast?`<div class="toast">${toast}</div>`:'');
if(cur=='track'){const r=document.getElementById('rt'),L=r.getTotalLength(),p=[.55,.55,.7,.88,1][Math.min(ord.stage,4)],pt=r.getPointAtLength(L*p);document.getElementById('cp').style.transform=`translate(${pt.x}px,${pt.y}px)`}}
render();
</script></body></html>
